sets.p: Here is a photograph. It shows people cooking. Please tell us what you can see in the photograph.
sets.pv: Đây là ảnh người đang nấu ăn. Hãy nói bạn thấy gì trong ảnh.
c: Ai trong ảnh, đang làm gì
Đồ vật, món ăn, nơi chốn
Đoán tình huống / cảm xúc (They look…, Maybe…)
sets.m: In this photo I can see two chefs in a kitchen. They are cooking. The man on the left is holding a pan, and there is some soup and a salad on the table. Maybe it is a restaurant kitchen. They look busy, but I think they are happy because they like cooking.

sets.p: Here is a photograph. It shows a family on holiday. Please tell us what you can see in the photograph.
sets.pv: Đây là ảnh một gia đình đi nghỉ. Hãy nói bạn thấy gì trong ảnh.
c: Ai trong ảnh, đang làm gì
Nơi chốn: bãi biển, đồ vật
Đoán thời tiết, cảm xúc
sets.m: This photo shows a family on a beach. There is a man, a woman and a girl. They are sitting near a big umbrella, and the girl is playing with a ball. I can see a boat on the sea. The weather looks hot and sunny. I think they are relaxing and enjoying their holiday.

sets.p: Here are your photographs. They show people studying in different places. Compare the photographs, and say what the advantages of studying in each place might be.
sets.pv: Hai ảnh: người học ở hai nơi khác nhau. So sánh hai ảnh và nói lợi ích của việc học ở mỗi nơi.
c: So sánh hai ảnh (both, whereas…)
Ảnh A: thư viện
Ảnh B: học trực tuyến ở nhà
Lợi ích của mỗi nơi
sets.m: Both photos show people studying, but in very different places. In the first photo, a student is working in a library, surrounded by books, whereas in the second one a young man is studying online at home on his laptop. The advantage of the library is that it's quiet, so it's easier to concentrate, and you can find all the books you need. On the other hand, studying at home is more comfortable and flexible, because you can choose when to work. Personally, I'd prefer the library before exams.

sets.p: Here are your photographs. They show people travelling in different ways. Compare the photographs, and say why the people might have chosen to travel in these ways.
sets.pv: Hai ảnh: người đi lại bằng hai cách. So sánh và nói vì sao họ có thể chọn cách đi đó.
c: So sánh hai ảnh
Ảnh A: đi tàu
Ảnh B: đi ô tô, kẹt xe
Lý do chọn cách đi (might, probably…)
sets.m: Both photos show people travelling, but in different ways. In the first one, a man is waiting for a train, while in the second photo there are lots of cars in heavy traffic. The man might have chosen the train because it's faster and he can relax or check his phone. On the other hand, the people driving probably need their cars because it's more convenient. Perhaps they have children or heavy bags. However, they look quite stressed in the traffic.

sets.p: Look at the photographs. They show people working in different situations. Compare two of the pictures and say what pressures the people might be under, and how they might be feeling.
sets.pv: Ba ảnh: người làm việc trong các hoàn cảnh khác nhau. Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh, nói họ có thể chịu áp lực gì và cảm thấy thế nào.
c: Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh
Áp lực có thể có
Cảm xúc có thể có
Từ suy đoán (might, could, I imagine…)
sets.m: I'm going to compare the office meeting and the construction site. In the first picture, the people seem to be under pressure to meet a deadline, and they might be feeling quite stressed, whereas the builder probably faces a different kind of pressure, which is safety, because the work could be dangerous. On the other hand, the people in the meeting can at least share the responsibility, while the builder may feel exhausted after a long day outdoors. I imagine both jobs are tiring in their own way.

sets.p: Look at the photographs. They show people doing physical activities. Compare two of the pictures and say why the people might have chosen these activities, and how beneficial they might be.
sets.pv: Ba ảnh: người tập thể dục. Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh, nói vì sao họ chọn hoạt động đó và có lợi thế nào.
c: Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh
Lý do chọn hoạt động
Lợi ích cho sức khoẻ, tinh thần
Từ suy đoán
sets.m: I'd like to compare the cyclists and the swimmers. The people cycling in the city might have chosen it because it's a convenient way to get to work and keep fit at the same time, whereas the swimmers are probably doing it to relax and reduce stress. Swimming is very healthy because it exercises the whole body, while cycling in traffic could be less beneficial if the air is polluted. On the other hand, both activities are good for your fitness, and I imagine they help people feel more energetic.
